external_primary_research.finding: stdlib wave supports only uncompressed PCM WAV in Python 3.13; format-tag-3 IEEE float is rejected.
IEEE-float WAV support is added only in Python 3.15, confirming a Python-runtime ABI boundary rather than a model-quality result.
nemo-speech transcribe accepts PCM16 and float32 WAV from 8-96 kHz and handles downmix/resampling internally.
